estate: SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM observation) AS observations, (SELECT count(DISTINCT src_id) FROM observation) AS sources, (SELECT count(*) FROM page) AS pages, (SELECT count(*) FROM parcel_flat) AS parcels_projected
coverage: SELECT src_id, count(*) AS rows FROM observation GROUP BY src_id ORDER BY rows DESC LIMIT 40
markets: WITH p AS (SELECT trim(json_extract_string(observed,'$.City')) AS city, TRY_CAST(trim(json_extract_string(observed,'$.Land_Value')) AS DOUBLE) AS lv, TRY_CAST(trim(json_extract_string(observed,'$.Improvemen')) AS DOUBLE) AS iv, TRY_CAST(trim(json_extract_string(observed,'$.Total_Valu')) AS DOUBLE) AS tv, TRY_CAST(trim(json_extract_string(observed,'$.Land_SqFt')) AS DOUBLE) AS sqft FROM observation WHERE src_id='src:tad-parcel-view') SELECT city, count(*) FILTER (WHERE iv=0 AND lv>0 AND sqft BETWEEN 3000 AND 20000) AS vacant_n, median(lv) FILTER (WHERE iv=0 AND lv>0 AND sqft BETWEEN 3000 AND 20000) AS land_median, count(*) FILTER (WHERE tv>0) AS improved_n, median(tv) FILTER (WHERE tv>0) AS exit_median FROM p GROUP BY city HAVING vacant_n >= 40 AND improved_n >= 500 ORDER BY improved_n DESC LIMIT 20
owners: SELECT trim(json_extract_string(observed,'$.Owner_Name')) AS owner, count(*) AS parcels FROM observation WHERE src_id='src:tad-parcel-view' AND trim(json_extract_string(observed,'$.Owner_Name')) <> '' GROUP BY 1 HAVING parcels >= 60 ORDER BY parcels DESC LIMIT 25
